jobs.title: All Planets Fit Between Earth and Moon
jobs.description:
Every other planet in our solar system - Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, Neptune, Venus, Mars and Mercury - can fit in the gap between Earth and the Moon when the Moon is at its farthest. And there's still over 9,000 km to spare!

#space #planets #solarsystem #science #shorts
